spans.s:
DERANGE: क्षोभयति, वि-, (c. of क्षुम्): v. To
disturb, confuse. D. d (in mind) उन्मत्तः (त्ता,
 त्तं): v. Insane.

DERANGEMENT:
I Confusion: q. v.: विक्षोभः।
II Insanity: q. v.

DERIDE: अवहसति, उप-, अप-, (हस्, c. l.): v.
To laugh at, ridicule.

DERISION:
(1) उपहासः;
(2) अवहासः: v. Ridi-
-cule, mockery.

DERISIVELY:
(1) सोपहासम्;
(2) सावहासम्;
(3)
सापहासम। Ph.:
d. and contemptuously:
अव-
हस्यावमन्य च, Mah.

DERIVATION:
I Lit.: of words, etc.: व्युत्पत्तिः।
II That which is derived: शाखा, “artificial
d.”: कृत्रिमशाखा।

DERIVE v.:
I To draw from: Ph.:
the race d. d
from the sun:
सूर्यप्रभवो वंशः, R.;
one who is d. d
from Virasena:
वोरसेनोद्भूतिः, N.: v. Origin,
arising from. II. Of words: व्युत्पत्तिं वदति
(वद्, c. l.): v. To say.
To be d. d:
व्युत्प-
द्यते (पद्, c. 4),
as being d. d in the passive
sense:
कर्मव्युत्पन्नतया, Da. com.

DEROGATE:
I To detract, disparage: q. v.
II To restrict: q. v.

DEROGATORY: expr. by subs.,
this is d. to
God:
*इदमीश्वरस्यावमानना: v. Detraction,
insult.
